meta.title: refactor: Python.NET wrapper with improved type conversions, error handling, and performance optimizations
meta.body_summary: Refactor Python.NET wrapper to improve type conversions, error handling, and performance; no breaking changes claimed.

perf_labels.notes: Copilot refactored Python.NET wrapper with narrative perf claims; maintainer repeatedly CHANGES_REQUESTED for failing tests/Codacy; agent cycled @staticmethod; PR closed after 7 days inactivity.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: At 848 changed lines across 19 files, this is a medium-sized refactor by absolute volume. As a performance-oriented wrapper refactor, it was closed—not merged—after repeated quality assurance failures and an unresolvable corrective cycle.

review_details.concern_detail: Maintainer DaveSkender issued six CHANGES_REQUESTED reviews citing failing unit tests and Codacy issues; the agent repeatedly added/removed the @staticmethod decorator on _verify_data, cycling between CI fix and Codacy fix; the PR was eventually closed for inactivity.
review_details.performance_claim: Improved type conversion performance and memory management in the .NET interop layer.
review_details.rejection_signals: PR closed by Devin bot after 7 days of no progress; maintainer expressed frustration with the cycling of errors.

capability_boundary.boundary_notes: Multi-file .NET interop refactor with quality gate requirements; the agent was unable to break out of a corrective loop between CI failures and static analysis warnings, leading to maintainer frustration and closure.

detection_detail.code_reading: DaveSkender reviewed inline code and pointed out that the @staticmethod decorator caused build errors; he also questioned the need for pylint disable comments.
detection_detail.ci_auto: CI tests failed multiple times due to the @staticmethod TypeError; Codacy raised linting issues throughout the review cycles.

maintainer_practices.reproducibility_notes: No benchmark or profiling evidence was provided; only narrative performance claims appear in the PR body.
maintainer_practices.regression_detail: After multiple rounds of fixes that failed to satisfy quality checks, the PR remained non‑compliant and was closed without merge.

core_change_summary.description: Refactored stock_indicators package: direct C# DateTime constructor, Decimal conversions, custom exceptions, pylint suppressions, keyword-only arguments, and a problematic @staticmethod addition/removal cycle in IndicatorResults.
core_change_summary.secondary_note: Remaining changes involve pylint disable comments and keyword-only argument enforcement; no performance observability instrumentation was added.
change_trajectory: Initial commit: introduced custom exceptions, direct DateTime/Decimal constructors, and enhanced Quote/Results validation.
First round: fixed unit tests and Codacy issues, but introduced @staticmethod on _verify_data.
CI fix: removed @staticmethod after it caused a TypeError in class creation; all 514 tests passed.
Codacy fix: re‑added @staticmethod to satisfy linting, causing the CI failure to reappear.
Subsequent cycles: repeated addition/removal of @staticmethod; maintainer commented on the cycling.
Final state: @staticmethod removed, but PR was closed by Devin bot due to inactivity.

review_signals.summary: Requested fixes for failing unit tests and Codacy issues; instructed not to change test logic.
review_signals.action_taken: Multiple commits attempted to fix, but the cycle continued.

review_signals.summary: Pointed out that the @staticmethod decorator on _verify_data caused the same build error.
review_signals.action_taken: Copilot removed the decorator, but later reinstated it during Codacy fixes.

review_signals.summary: Warned that the agent was cycling to and from the same errors (static method vs Codacy).
review_signals.action_taken: Final removal of @staticmethod, but PR remained blocked.

review_signals.summary: Closed PR due to inactivity for more than 7 days.
Provided a non‑blocking overview of the PR changes and raised potential issues (e.g., overload signature inconsistency).
Flagged duplicate exception definitions, unused imports, incorrect return annotation, microsecond precision, and misleading comments.

collaboration_trajectory: Copilot opened the PR with a large refactor, claiming performance and error‑handling improvements.
Maintainer DaveSkender quickly responded with CHANGES_REQUESTED for failing tests and Codacy issues.
Agent committed fixes but introduced a @staticmethod that broke CI; a cycle of adding/removing the decorator ensued.
After several rounds, the maintainer flagged the cycling, and the PR stalled.
Devin bot auto‑closed the PR after 7 days of inactivity.
